europe_now.title: Widespread Protests and Unrest Across France
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators have taken part in massive protests across France for three consecutive weeks. The demonstrations, which have also seen clashes between protesters and police, highlight growing public frustration over cost-of-living pressures.

sources.headline: Hundreds of thousands protest in France for "Act III"
Hundreds of thousands of protesters march across France for third week in a row

europe_now.title: Violent Cost-of-Living Protests in Germany
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations across Germany over economic pressures and education funding have escalated into violence. Police and protesters have clashed in urban areas, with reports of widespread looting during the unrest.

sources.headline: 'Gen Z' demonstrations across Germany demand more education funding

top_stories.title: Humanitarian Evacuations from Occupied Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian civilians have successfully been evacuated from the long-occupied frontline city of Oleshky. The newly arrived evacuees have been reunited with their families following years of hardship.

sources.headline: 'We came back from hell', say Ukrainians after years in Russia-occupied frontline city
Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city

top_stories.title: European Diplomatic Tensions Over Russia at G20
top_stories.summary: European officials have warned that a potential return of Vladimir Putin to the G20 summit risks normalizing Russian war crimes. Ministers remain divided over how to handle international engagement and diplomatic stance toward Moscow.
